title: Flat ordinary scalar units compute derived units
statement: Let $C$ be a category with objects in $\operatorname{Type}(u+1)$, morphisms in $\operatorname{Type}(u)$, and essentially small in universe $u+1$. Let $J$ be a Grothendieck topology on $C$. Let $R,A$ be commutative rings in $\operatorname{Type}(u+1)$, $\varphi:R\to A$ a ring homomorphism, $F$ a sheaf of $R$-modules, $G$ a sheaf of $A$-modules, and $\eta:F\to\operatorname{Res}_{\varphi}G$, where restriction is [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. Suppose $F$ is flat: tensoring with $F$ preserves finite limits and finite colimits in the monoidal category of $R$-module sheaves. Suppose, for every $A$-module sheaf $H$, composition with $\eta$ induces a bijection $\operatorname{Hom}(G,H)\to\operatorname{Hom}(F,\operatorname{Res}_{\varphi}H)$. Then $\eta$ satisfies scalarUniversal [def-geo-exact-degree-zero-interface]: the induced map $F[0]\to D(\operatorname{Res}_{\varphi})(G[0])$ induces bijections $\operatorname{Hom}(G[0],N)\to\operatorname{Hom}(F[0],D(\operatorname{Res}_{\varphi})(N))$ for every unbounded derived $A$-module sheaf $N$. No flatness of $A$ over $R$ is assumed.

source.place: Tags 06YQ (lemma-bounded-flat-K-flat), 06YY (lemma-derived-base-change), and 07A6 (lemma-adjoint), for identity of the site with a map of constant coefficient rings

proof.text: Construct ordinary extension E as composeAndSheafify of ModuleCat.extendScalars and use Sheaf.adjunction to obtain E adjoint to exact restriction U. The identity on ordinary tensor products gives extendScalars followed by restrictScalars isomorphic to tensorLeft of the restricted regular A-module. Restriction commutes with sheafification because it also has a right adjoint. Combine sheafComposeNatIso, the strong monoidal sheafification comparison and the sheafification counit to construct extensionRestrictIso: E followed by U is tensorLeft of the sheafified restricted regular A-module. These are the proved private helpers moduleExtendRestrictIso and extensionRestrictIso.

An acyclic K-flat complex stays acyclic after tensoring with any object, by the adopted source theorem CochainComplex.acyclic_tensorRight_of_kFlat. Use braiding and extensionRestrictIso to deduce acyclicity after E followed by U. Exact faithful restriction reflects acyclicity. Functor.PreservesKFlatQuasiIso.mk', which applies this argument to mapping cones, proves E preserves quasi-isomorphisms between K-flat complexes. This is extension_preservesKFlatQuasiIso; it makes no flatness assumption on A.

Derive E adjoint to U using the existing generic derived adjunction, and identify the derived right functor of exact U with U.mapDerivedCategory. The single complex F[0] is K-flat by the adopted source criterion CochainComplex.kFlat_single_obj_iff_flat. Apply the K-flat cochain-transpose theorem to make the transpose of its localized ordinary unit invertible. The proved single_unit_square checks the termwise ordinary unit in degree zero, with zero source in all other degrees. derived_single_unit_square then uses naturality of the exact localization comparison and the exact-single comparison to identify its postcomposition with the E single-complex isomorphism with the exact unit specified in the statement.

Let q:EF to G be the ordinary adjunction transpose of eta. For every H, postcomposition with q followed by the adjunction Hom equivalence is exactly postcomposition with eta, hence is bijective. Coyoneda detects isomorphisms, so q is invertible. The adjunction unit equation gives eta = unit(F) followed by U(q); naturality of the exact-single comparison gives the same equation for the raw derived units. Compose the invertible cochain transpose from the previous step with q[0]. Postcomposition with this isomorphism followed by the derived adjunction Hom equivalence gives the required bijections for every unbounded N. Finally scalarUniversal is definitionally the named Universal property for restriction.

lean.statement:
theorem scalarUniversal_of_flat
    {C : Type (u + 1)} [Category.{u} C] [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} C]
    (J : GrothendieckTopology C) {R A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing R] [CommRing A]
    (φ : R →+* A) (F : Sheaf J (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R))
    (G : Sheaf J (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))
    (η : F ⟶ (Sheaf.restrictScalars J φ).obj G)
    (hF : ObjectProperty.flat F)
    (hη : ∀ H : Sheaf J (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A),
      Function.Bijective (fun f : G ⟶ H ↦ η ≫ (Sheaf.restrictScalars J φ).map f)) :
    scalarUniversal J φ F G η
